name: retry-merge
description: Draft → review loop until APPROVED → finalize

nodes.name: draft
nodes.prompt: Write a 3-bullet status draft for this workspace. Plain text only.

nodes.name: review
nodes.prompt:
Review the draft below. If it is clear and concrete, reply with exactly APPROVED on the first line, then a one-line note. Otherwise reply with REVISE and what to fix.

{draft}

nodes.name: final
nodes.prompt:
Produce the final short status note from:

{review}
